set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/Antigravity_additions
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/uv
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity
uv sync --frozen --extra dev --extra mcp --python 3.12
config.start_skill:
Use the existing isolated checkout at /workspace/Antigravity_additions; do not create a Git worktree unless explicitly requested. Preserve tracked files during environment setup; make source changes only when the user requests coding work.

Activate the prepared development environment:
```bash
cd /workspace/Antigravity_additions
export PATH=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity/bin:$PATH
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.cache/uv
export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/workspace/.venvs/antigravity
cochem --version
cochem-mcp --version
cochem-pipeline --version
cochem-supervisor --version
python -m pytest pipeline_tests mcp_tests supervisor_tests -q
```
Use explicit test directories: the repository's historical default testpaths names an absent ignored tests directory. These suites exercise native CLI adapter contracts, physical subprocesses, real SQLite/concurrency, real loopback HTTP and OS resource measurements. Clearly labelled fixture CLI output does not establish live model inference. Windows SYSTEM/ACL/Job Object integration tests deliberately skip on Linux. No persistent service is needed for these development checks.

The production pipeline retained from 4.2.2 requires Windows Python 3.12+, a machine-protected installation, SYSTEM Scheduled Task, separate worker identities and subscription logins. Read docs/PIPELINE_4.2.2.md and docs/REQUIREMENTS_4.2.2.md. Do not try to bypass the Linux fail-closed guard or claim Windows acceptance here. The Agy headless/auth/result contract must be verified on the actual Windows host; the example config contains rejected placeholders. scripts/inspect_agy_windows.ps1 captures version/help without inference. scripts/verify_pipeline_acceptance.py requires explicit --run-live and real configured providers, and uses the running authenticated service.

The existing scientific library remains available. Optional GPU/ML, ORCA/CREST/xTB/Open Babel, unrelated legacy v4 suites and their known Windows-dependent failures are outside the pipeline readiness claim. Never copy credentials into this setup, source control or logs. Use existing native CLI subscription login and the platform Git proxy; do not request API keys as a substitute.

The supervisor introduced in 4.2.3 is a separate protected Windows installation/venv with its own incident ledger. Read docs/SUPERVISOR_4.2.3.md before configuring its daemon, repair identity, source allowlist, external immutable acceptance tests, release pointer or native repair CLI. Default policy: one restart before model escalation for heartbeat/native-status incidents; two repair reservations per incident, four per UTC day, and a 30-minute cooldown. Operator request-update uses this same bounded gate. auto_deploy=false leaves a validated candidate BLOCKED; no manual promotion command exists. Repair cannot modify the protected supervisor, tests, policy or dependencies; database/schema migration is outside its code-release mechanism. Live candidate smoke checks add provider quota beyond the repair call. Linux contract tests do not prove Windows or live-model repair acceptance. The local proposed setup JSON has not been applied to a cloud draft: the earlier save returned stale_base. Do not retry that stale draft; a future setup chat can apply the recipe to a fresh draft.

For 4.2.4, read docs/ROUTING_4.2.4.md and docs/RELEASE_4.2.4.md. The corrected routing bands are 1-3 Flash/Haiku/Luna, 4-6 Sonnet/Sol/Gemini Pro, 7-9 Opus/Astra low/Gemini Pro, and 10 Fable/Astra ultra (only two routes). Controller-scored content selects the immutable route policy; model-supplied scores do not grant authority. Final synthesis remains Gemini 3.1 Pro. Route ceilings of zero mean no operator ceiling; availability waits use durable bounded backoff. Upgrade through a fresh protected Supervisor4.2.4 source/test snapshot, preserve native worker/repair credentials and task names, and migrate the previous supervisor ledger using the SYSTEM SQLite-backup helper. Do not reset repair budgets or reuse frozen 4.2.3 acceptance policy for 4.2.4 routing. Prior tasks must be stopped and disabled; activation follows full Windows Restart and real host acceptance.
